quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Having a long-standing habit that is very unlikely to change.
quests.explanation: Inveterate describes a deeply ingrained habit or tendency, often built up over many years. Collectors, gamblers, or travellers are commonly described this way when the habit runs very deep.
quests.textToSpeak: As an inveterate collector of vintage cameras, he could rarely resist a visit to the flea market.
quests.textWithBlanks: As an ___ collector of vintage cameras, he could rarely resist a visit to the flea market.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Not harmed or damaged at all, especially after something dangerous.
quests.explanation: Unscathed describes coming through danger without any harm at all. 'Remarkably' signals just how lucky and unusual this outcome was.
quests.textToSpeak: Remarkably, the driver walked away completely unscathed after the car rolled twice.
quests.textWithBlanks: Remarkably, the driver walked away completely ___ after the car rolled twice.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Unpredictable changes or events that are hard to control or plan for.
quests.explanation: Vagaries describes unpredictable ups and downs, often beyond anyone's control. Weather is one of the most classic examples used with this word.
quests.textToSpeak: Farmers have always had to adapt to the vagaries of the weather.
quests.textWithBlanks: Farmers have always had to adapt to the ___ of the weather.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Done quickly and without real interest or care, just to meet a basic expectation.
quests.explanation: Perfunctory describes actions done half-heartedly, just to fulfil a minimum expectation. Returning straight to his phone shows exactly how little real attention was given.
quests.textToSpeak: He gave a perfunctory nod before returning his attention to his phone.
quests.textWithBlanks: He gave a ___ nod before returning his attention to his phone.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Charming and attractive in a way that can be slightly misleading or hard to resist.
quests.explanation: Beguiling describes an almost irresistible charm, sometimes with a hint of deception. Cities described this way often have visitors extending their trips unexpectedly.
quests.textToSpeak: There was something beguiling about the old city that made visitors want to stay longer.
quests.textWithBlanks: There was something ___ about the old city that made visitors want to stay longer.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Excessive confidence or boldness in taking a risk, especially with someone more powerful.
quests.explanation: Temerity describes bold, almost reckless confidence, especially when challenging authority. Questioning a CEO directly is a vivid example of this kind of nerve.
quests.textToSpeak: Nobody expected the junior employee to have the temerity to question the CEO directly.
quests.textWithBlanks: Nobody expected the junior employee to have the ___ to question the CEO directly.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Excessively sweet, sentimental, or emotional, to an unpleasant degree.
quests.explanation: Cloying describes emotion or sweetness taken so far it becomes unpleasant. 'Sentimentality piled on far too thickly' explains exactly what critics disliked.
quests.textToSpeak: The film's ending felt slightly cloying, with sentimentality piled on far too thickly.
quests.textWithBlanks: The film's ending felt slightly ___, with sentimentality piled on far too thickly.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Showing great knowledge gained through wide reading and study.
quests.explanation: Erudite describes deep, wide-ranging learning, often shown through speech or writing. Ranging 'effortlessly' across several subjects is a strong sign of this kind of knowledge.
quests.textToSpeak: The professor's erudite lecture ranged effortlessly across history, philosophy, and art.
quests.textWithBlanks: The professor's ___ lecture ranged effortlessly across history, philosophy, and art.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Concerned only with a narrow, local area, and not open to wider or outside perspectives.
quests.explanation: Parochial describes a narrow, local outlook that ignores the bigger picture. This is a common criticism aimed at media seen as ignoring international perspectives.
quests.textToSpeak: Critics accused the newspaper of taking an overly parochial view of what counted as important news.
quests.textWithBlanks: Critics accused the newspaper of taking an overly ___ view of what counted as important news.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Showing no fear or hesitation, even when describing something difficult or unpleasant.
quests.explanation: Unflinching describes total honesty or courage, even under difficult circumstances. 'Holding nothing back' reinforces exactly how direct and complete her account was.
quests.textToSpeak: She gave an unflinching account of the disaster, holding nothing back from the committee.
quests.textWithBlanks: She gave an ___ account of the disaster, holding nothing back from the committee.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Relating to clothing and personal style, especially fashionable clothing.
quests.explanation: Sartorial relates specifically to clothing and style choices. This word appears almost exclusively in discussions about fashion and personal appearance.
quests.textToSpeak: The actor's sartorial choices at the premiere were praised across every fashion magazine.
quests.textWithBlanks: The actor's ___ choices at the premiere were praised across every fashion magazine.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A serious, dignified manner that commands respect and attention.
quests.explanation: Gravitas describes a dignified seriousness that naturally earns respect. Speaking calmly yet still commanding attention is a classic sign of real gravitas.
quests.textToSpeak: Even without raising his voice, the retired general spoke with real gravitas.
quests.textWithBlanks: Even without raising his voice, the retired general spoke with real ___.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Deliberately challenging established beliefs, traditions, or ways of doing things.
quests.explanation: Iconoclastic describes a deliberate rejection of tradition or convention. 'Broke almost every rule' shows exactly how far this director pushed against expectations.
quests.textToSpeak: The director's iconoclastic approach to storytelling broke almost every rule of traditional cinema.
quests.textWithBlanks: The director's ___ approach to storytelling broke almost every rule of traditional cinema.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Not interested in other people, ideas, or cultures beyond your own immediate group.
quests.explanation: Insular describes a closed-off outlook, often shaped by isolation. A remote island is a very literal, understandable cause of this kind of insularity.
quests.textToSpeak: Living on a small, remote island had made the community somewhat insular in its outlook.
quests.textWithBlanks: Living on a small, remote island had made the community somewhat ___ in its outlook.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The past form of 'erode' — to gradually wear away or weaken something over time.
quests.explanation: Eroded means gradually worn away, much like rock eroded by water. Trust is one of the things most commonly described as eroding slowly rather than collapsing suddenly.
quests.textToSpeak: Years of broken promises had slowly eroded the public's trust in the institution.
quests.textWithBlanks: Years of broken promises had slowly ___ the public's trust in the institution.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Extremely careful and precise about small details, especially rules of correct behaviour.
quests.explanation: Punctilious describes obsessive attention to small, correct details. Rejecting a whole draft over one comma illustrates this trait taken to its extreme.
quests.textToSpeak: The editor was famously punctilious about grammar, rejecting drafts over a single misplaced comma.
quests.textWithBlanks: The editor was famously ___ about grammar, rejecting drafts over a single misplaced comma.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Lasting for only a very short time before disappearing.
quests.explanation: Ephemeral describes something fleeting, gone almost as quickly as it appeared. Viral internet fame is one of the most fitting modern examples of this word.
quests.textToSpeak: Fame on social media can be remarkably ephemeral, vanishing again within weeks.
quests.textWithBlanks: Fame on social media can be remarkably ___, vanishing again within weeks.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: So unique and distinctive that it cannot be successfully copied by anyone else.
quests.explanation: Inimitable describes a style so original it resists genuine imitation. 'Copied by many but matched by none' captures this idea perfectly.
quests.textToSpeak: The comedian's inimitable style has been copied by many but matched by none.
quests.textWithBlanks: The comedian's ___ style has been copied by many but matched by none.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Excessive pride or confidence that eventually leads to a serious downfall.
quests.explanation: Hubris describes dangerous overconfidence, often shown just before a major failure. This word appears constantly in stories, both historical and modern, about dramatic downfalls.
quests.textToSpeak: Many historians blame the empire's fall on the sheer hubris of its final rulers.
quests.textWithBlanks: Many historians blame the empire's fall on the sheer ___ of its final rulers.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Widely told and believed, but probably not actually true or accurate.
quests.explanation: Apocryphal describes popular stories of doubtful truth, often repeated anyway. 'Still widely repeated' shows how these stories can survive despite the doubt around them.
quests.textToSpeak: The famous story about the invention is probably apocryphal, though it's still widely repeated.
quests.textWithBlanks: The famous story about the invention is probably ___, though it's still widely repeated.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Providing a strong feeling of relief from difficult emotions by expressing them fully.
quests.explanation: Cathartic describes the relief that comes from fully expressing a difficult emotion. Writing, art, or talking are all common, healthy ways people experience this.
quests.textToSpeak: Writing about the experience turned out to be genuinely cathartic for her.
quests.textWithBlanks: Writing about the experience turned out to be genuinely ___ for her.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Experienced indirectly, through imagining or watching someone else's actions or feelings.
quests.explanation: Vicarious describes feeling something indirectly through someone else's experience. Parents watching their children succeed often describe their pride using exactly this word.
quests.textToSpeak: Watching her daughter succeed on stage gave her a real sense of vicarious pride.
quests.textWithBlanks: Watching her daughter succeed on stage gave her a real sense of ___ pride.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Extremely idealistic and unrealistic, often in a way that seems admirable but impractical.
quests.explanation: Quixotic describes idealistic ambition detached from practical reality. Attempting something huge with 'no sailing experience' captures this idea vividly.
quests.textToSpeak: His quixotic plan to sail around the world alone, with no sailing experience, worried his family.
quests.textWithBlanks: His ___ plan to sail around the world alone, with no sailing experience, worried his family.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Giving fully and without holding anything back.
quests.explanation: Unstinting describes generosity given completely and without limits. 'Never once had to turn away a family' shows the real, practical result of this generosity.
quests.textToSpeak: Her unstinting generosity meant the shelter never once had to turn away a family in need.
quests.textWithBlanks: Her ___ generosity meant the shelter never once had to turn away a family in need.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: So used to something unpleasant that it no longer bothers or affects you.
quests.explanation: Inured describes becoming numb to something through long, repeated exposure. Years of daily exposure to financial pressure is a believable cause of this.
quests.textToSpeak: Years on the trading floor had left him inured to the daily stress of huge financial risk.
quests.textWithBlanks: Years on the trading floor had left him ___ to the daily stress of huge financial risk.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Having sharp judgement and practical intelligence, especially in business or money matters.
quests.explanation: Shrewd describes sharp, practical judgement, especially in business. Surviving a recession 'intact' shows exactly how valuable this instinct turned out to be.
quests.textToSpeak: Her shrewd business instincts helped the small company survive the recession intact.
quests.textWithBlanks: Her ___ business instincts helped the small company survive the recession intact.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: So unpleasant or difficult to accept that it's hard to face directly.
quests.explanation: Unpalatable describes a truth so unpleasant it's difficult to accept, much like disgusting food. 'Completely failed' shows exactly what made this truth so hard to swallow.
quests.textToSpeak: The board had to accept the unpalatable truth that the project had completely failed.
quests.textWithBlanks: The board had to accept the ___ truth that the project had completely failed.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Understood by only a small number of people with specialised knowledge.
quests.explanation: Esoteric describes knowledge so specialised that most people find it inaccessible. 'Half the audience got lost' shows exactly how narrow this specialist knowledge was.
quests.textToSpeak: The lecture covered such esoteric details of tax law that half the audience got lost.
quests.textWithBlanks: The lecture covered such ___ details of tax law that half the audience got lost.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: So strong or memorable that it can never be forgotten or removed.
quests.explanation: Indelible describes a mark or memory so strong it's permanent. Powerful experiences are often described as leaving exactly this kind of lasting impression.
quests.textToSpeak: The trip left an indelible impression on everyone who experienced it.
quests.textWithBlanks: The trip left an ___ impression on everyone who experienced it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Showing complete, expert skill and mastery in a particular role or profession.
quests.explanation: Consummate describes complete mastery and skill in a role. Staying entirely professional despite personal feelings is a strong, practical example of this quality.
quests.textToSpeak: As a consummate professional, she never let her personal feelings affect her work.
quests.textWithBlanks: As a ___ professional, she never let her personal feelings affect her work.
